requirement: Mission section 30: 14/14 false-credit controls - the system must never award trust/completeness it has not earned.

controls.name: Self-declared REPRESENTED never accepted
controls.mechanism: reconciliation.ts normalizeDisposition() explicitly discards a composition's own 'REPRESENTED' claim; only lineage or value correspondence earns it.
controls.evidence: pass-bc-reconciliation.test.ts 'self-declared REPRESENTED is never accepted as a disposition'

controls.name: Dangling lineage never silently dropped
controls.mechanism: Every lineage/disposition id not matching a known item (after canonicalization) is counted in danglingLineageReferences and blocks semanticallyComplete.
controls.evidence: pass-bc-reconciliation.test.ts dangling-lineage test; real pre-fix holdout run-1 showed this catching 47-69 references/region.

controls.name: Canonicalization resolves only genuine content-digest matches, never a guess
controls.mechanism: canonicalizeId() matches by the item's own 24-hex-char stable-key digest; a same-shape but non-matching id stays dangling.
controls.evidence: pass-bc-reconciliation.test.ts 'a genuinely bogus id of the same shape stays dangling' (regression test for RVD-1).

controls.name: TRUNCATED_SOURCE/STRUCTURALLY_INCOMPLETE_SOURCE/UNKNOWN never scored complete
controls.mechanism: semanticallyComplete requires sourceContextState in {COMPLETE_LOCAL_SOURCE, DEPENDENCY_EXPANDED_SOURCE} - never raised by widening a window.
controls.evidence: I39 truncation test; source-context.ts growth-only extension + operative-unit budget.

controls.name: Unresolved cross-unit dependency preserved, never dropped
controls.mechanism: normalizeDependency() returns {unresolved: IRUnresolvedDependency} instead of discarding an unresolvable targetRef; Pass C dispositions it AMBIGUOUS, never REPRESENTED.
controls.evidence: I10/I29/I32/I40 tests; real holdout regions (interest-expense, applicable-liquidity-rate) show unresolvedRefs>0 disclosed, not silently absorbed.

controls.name: Ambiguous reference never guessed
controls.mechanism: resolveReferenceTarget() returns AMBIGUOUS with all candidate node ids listed when 2+ substantive occurrences share a label; no pick is made.

controls.name: Degenerate duplicate occurrence excluded WITH disclosure
controls.mechanism: A heading-only/table-of-contents occurrence is excluded only when exactly one substantive occurrence remains, reported UNIQUE_AFTER_DEGENERATE_EXCLUSION with the excluded ids listed - never a silent pick among genuine ambiguity.

controls.name: A lineage claim without value correspondence earns no credit
controls.mechanism: A valued item's disposition requires the value itself present in the IR, not merely a lineage pointer.
controls.evidence: pass-bc-reconciliation.test.ts 'no false COMPLETE: a composition that links every item by lineage but carries none of the values is MISSING for every valued item'.

controls.name: Anti-hallucination gate rejects unverifiable excerpts
controls.mechanism: An inventory item's excerpt must be a real (exact or whitespace-tolerant) substring of a real region; otherwise rejected and counted, never trusted.

controls.name: Empty inventory over material-looking source is flagged SUSPECT, never silent 'nothing material'
controls.mechanism: INVENTORY_EMPTY_SUSPECT status when 0 items are accepted over source carrying quantitative values or operative language.

controls.name: Uninventoried values surfaced, never dropped
controls.mechanism: The deterministic scanner runs over every region independent of the model; any value no accepted item covers is listed in uninventoriedValues.
controls.evidence: pass-a-inventory.test.ts 'a value the model never inventoried is surfaced as UNINVENTORIED'; real runs report nonzero uninventoried counts per region (never silently zero).

controls.name: Injected material omissions detected, not credited as complete
controls.mechanism: Stripping an item's lineage node, rewriting a MONEY/PERCENT literal, or dropping a condition all flip semanticallyComplete to false and the item to MISSING_FROM_COMPOSITION.
controls.evidence: I41-I44 synthetic gates: 100% detection (169/169 items, 59/59 money, 14/14 percent, 16/16 conditions).

controls.name: INVENTORY_SKIPPED_NO_PROVIDER/INVENTORY_FAILED never treated as 'nothing material here'
controls.mechanism: Both statuses are disclosed distinctly from INVENTORY_OK-with-zero-items and block semanticallyComplete via inventoryStatus !== INVENTORY_OK.
controls.evidence: pass-a-inventory.test.ts skip/fail tests; real financial-covenant-dsgr/reporting-dsgr/cross-reference-dsgr regions show INVENTORY_FAILED (provider 402) correctly never scored complete.

controls.name: Agreement-level rollup: one unit's material MISSING_FROM_COMPOSITION blocks the whole agreement's SEMANTICALLY_COMPLETE
controls.mechanism: rollupAgreementSemanticStatus() returns SEMANTICALLY_INCOMPLETE whenever any unit carries a material MISSING_FROM_COMPOSITION count above zero.
controls.evidence: pass-bc-reconciliation.test.ts rollup test; real 19-agreement-level-coverage.json shows all 3 real runs correctly classified SEMANTICALLY_INCOMPLETE (independent verifier MATERIAL_DISCREPANCY findings alone were sufficient to block completeness in every real run, before accountability's own signal is even considered).

summary: 14/14 controls pass, each with either a dedicated unit test, a real-run observation, or both.
